source_facts: Patch Review is a P1 core product surface; LLM residual classification is optional assistance, not authority.
acceptance: Every hunk has exactly one primary bucket.
Scope/protected/docs/supplementary-test rules are deterministic where possible.
Unattributed >0 blocks approve.
Acceptance independence gaps are explicit.
strict_waived can never display as strict_satisfied.

tasks.title: Runtime usage and human-control measurement recorder
tasks.goal: Automatically record P1 phase timing, runtime usage and control/execution LLM cost attribution.
source_facts: P1 Trust Gate requires automatic human/control/cost/latency baseline.
acceptance: Recorder writes phase start/end/active/wall facts.
LLM usage stores cost_plane at call time.
No manual Task fields are needed to produce metrics.
Missing provider usage is represented as unavailable, not zero.

tasks.title: P1 Context builder from refs and redacted verification projection
tasks.goal: Assemble minimal real ContextPack from Task refs, relevant docs/code/tests and redacted VerificationContract.
source_facts: Current repo has requirement/project knowledge but no v1.3 ContextPack selection path.
acceptance: Includes requested product/requirement/ADR refs.
Records included/excluded refs and selection reason.
Held-out internals are filtered from all sources.
Token budget is enforced deterministically enough for P1.

tasks.title: Worker integration for v1.3 Codegen/Verify vertical path
tasks.goal: Wire the P1 vertical path into worker without replacing legacy environment/failure jobs and without implementing P2 automation.
source_facts: cmd/worker is a high-conflict hotspot intentionally serialized.
P0 legacy functionality must continue working.
acceptance: Worker can execute one approved standard TaskContract through CodegenRun→ChangeSet→Verification.
Legacy jobs remain registered.
Codex/Fake selection is configuration, not core conditional logic.
No primary worktree mutation.
Held-out isolation/canary prerequisite enforced.

tasks.title: Minimal P1 Tasks/Changes web UI
tasks.goal: Add minimal P1 UI for real TaskContract/ChangeSet/Verification/Patch Review, keeping old execution summary clearly legacy.
source_facts: P1 UI scope is Tasks + Changes/Run Detail + Patch Review only.
acceptance: Task page shows derived state/current Run/verification summary.
Change page shows immutable ChangeSet, VerificationRun/Evidence, hunk inventory, functional+independence coverage.
Unattributed changes disable approve.
Approval writes HumanApprovalEvidence, not status.
No Inbox/Saved Views/Failures redesign.

tasks.title: v1.3 architecture invariant tests
tasks.goal: Land machine-checkable architecture tests for P1-active stable invariant IDs.
source_facts: Latest PRD requires invariant IDs and activation-stage tests.
acceptance: Tests cover no direct authoritative state write, ChangeSet immutability, held-out boundary at observable channels, proposal/fact separation, hunk accounting entry points.
P2/P4/P5 inactive invariants are not forced into fake implementations.

tasks.title: Update implementation-facing project instructions to v1.3 baseline
tasks.goal: Remove old v3/legacy guidance that would cause future Codex runs to implement against stale semantics; point to v1.3 and document only shipped P0/P1 behavior.
source_facts: Current CLAUDE.md/docs predate v1.3 and describe legacy task/failure platform.
Do not claim P2+ features are implemented.
acceptance: Latest PRD is clearly authoritative.
Old iron rules are reconciled with stable v1.3 invariants.
Operations/test docs match actual commands/schema.
P2+ remains explicitly deferred.

tasks.title: E2E: standard Task with visible + held-out PASS
tasks.goal: Prove one real P1 standard task travels end-to-end with held-out final verification.
source_facts: P1 Trust Gate explicitly requires this scenario.
acceptance: TaskContract and VerificationContract revisions trace to Run/ChangeSet/Evidence.
Implementation context cannot resolve held-out content.
Visible incremental checks can run.
Held-out final PASS contributes information independence.
Derived state reaches VERIFIED only after required evidence.

tasks.title: E2E: held-out FAIL blocks VERIFIED
tasks.goal: Construct one controlled held-out failure and prove it cannot silently become VERIFIED.
source_facts: P1 requires blocking behavior, not automated recovery.
acceptance: Held-out failure details remain control-plane only.
Task derives NEEDS_REVIEW/non-VERIFIED.
No automatic Rung-1/Rung-2 recovery is implemented.
Failure evidence remains append-only.

tasks.title: E2E: exposure fact flips information independence
tasks.goal: Prove an observable exposure is recorded and effective information independence becomes compromised for the applicable ChangeSet lineage.
source_facts: P1 Trust Gate requires at least one exposure flip scenario.
acceptance: ExposureEvent is append-only.
Frozen VerificationContract visibility policy is unchanged.
Derived independence flips to compromised.
Review shows the gap.

tasks.title: E2E: immutable ChangeSet and supersession fact
tasks.goal: Prove a new candidate is a new immutable ChangeSet and prior snapshot is related only by append-only supersession fact.
source_facts: Latest PRD fixed earlier multi-run mutable ChangeSet ambiguity.
acceptance: Run with no candidate creates no ChangeSet.
Candidate A and B are distinct immutable records.
Supersession does not mutate A.
Verification is bound to exact snapshot.

tasks.title: P1 metric baseline report generation
tasks.goal: Produce the P1 baseline distributions/readouts without inventing readiness thresholds.
source_facts: P1 records distributions but does not decide economic value vs bare agent.
acceptance: Reports human/control/wall/cost data.
Reports qualification strength, authoring mode, visibility, source/info independence.
Reports first-pass visible-only vs with-holdout where data exists.
Missing/low-sample metrics are marked insufficient, not zero or pass.

tasks.title: P1 Vertical Trust Gate review
tasks.goal: Perform the closed P1 Trust Readiness review. This task may PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED; it does not implement fixes.
source_facts: P1 exit is trust/readiness only, not “Tally beats bare Codex”.
acceptance: Primary worktree contamination=0.
Protected evidence silent modification=0.
Known false VERIFIED=0.
Traceability and hunk accounting=100% for P1 scenarios.
Fake/Codex conformance evidence recorded.
Required holdout/exposure scenarios executed.
Human/cost/latency baseline exists.
No P2 scope is required for PASS.
notes: Use GATE_REVIEW_PROMPT.md. Do not patch failing code in this task.
